verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a self-serve marketplace: the search page is the main portal for finding machines, filterable by GPU type, and hosts set their own prices (docs-41, docs-51, docs-33). Per-GPU-hour prices are therefore discoverable without sales, but they come as variable host offers rather than a published fixed rate per GPU type, and one user complained it takes many clicks to find even an approximate price (comm-3). missing for 10: a published standardized per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page, evidence that pricing is viewable without logging in, independent corroboration that prices are easy to find.
